premises.text: Consumers want smart home lighting but existing wired switches and smart bulbs make adoption painful
premises.evidence_span: attempts to date have failed to make this easy

premises.text: Magnet-mounted mechanical actuator automates a standard light switch at similar price to alternatives
premises.evidence_span: for about the same price as all these other products, you can install smart lighting like that, and you're done

premises.text: Phone control plus retained manual switch use, including timers that mimic natural behavior
premises.evidence_span: they can even mimic your natural behavior

premises.text: Product works for renters/condos where in-wall installs are forbidden
premises.evidence_span: if you live in an apartment or condo, you can't even use this option

premises.text: Launch path: pre-order campaign, experienced hardware manufacturer, Amazon/web, then retail in 2016
premises.evidence_span: we hope to deliver to online retail, such as Amazon, and through our own website

premises.text: Designed for both techies and non-techies outside Silicon Valley norms

value.text: Users get extremely simple smart lighting without painful install
